mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_review ( review_id, product_id, store_id, order_item_id, writer_user_id, rating, title, content, image_url, product_tags ) VALUES ( PRODUCT_REVIEW_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{storeId}, #{orderItemId}, #{writerUserId}, #{rating}, #{title}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{productTags} )
mapper.select:
SELECT review_id AS reviewId, product_id AS productId, store_id AS storeId, order_item_id AS orderItemId, writer_user_id AS writerUserId, rating, title, content, image_url AS imageUrl, like_count AS likeCount, is_visible AS isVisible, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate, reply, product_tags AS productTags FROM product_review WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_visible = 'Y'
AND (title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY
created_date DESC rating DESC review_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE product_review SET reply = #{reply}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.select: select s.store_id from product p, store s where product_id=#{product_id} and p.producer_id=s.producer_id
